# Reviewed exceptions to allowed-licenses.txt. One per line:   <ecosystem>:<package> | <licence seen> | <reason> | <approved by, date>
# ecosystem is "pip" or "npm"; the package name is matched case-insensitively, any version.
# An exception is a legal/product decision: do not add one in the same PR that introduces the dependency without review by the
# security owners (CODEOWNERS). Empty on purpose: nothing has been reviewed yet.
#
# NOTE the apps NXERP deploys are not third-party packages for this check and are excluded by tools/resolve_python_deps.py:
# ERPNext is GPL-3.0 and Helpdesk is AGPL-3.0 (their own licence files). The obligations of shipping them together with a
# proprietary nxerp app are an OWNER/LEGAL decision (docs/governance/owner-action-list.md); this file does not settle it.

# --- found by the first run of tools/check_licenses.py against Frappe's own dependency set (PyPI metadata, 2026-10-28) ---
# These two pass ONLY because they are listed as PENDING; the approver field must become a real name and date after review.
pip:mysqlclient | GPL-2.0-or-later (PyPI classifier) | MariaDB driver required by Frappe; GPL obligations when shipped in a proprietary image need review | PENDING legal review
pip:typst | no licence metadata on PyPI | pulled in by Frappe (PDF/print); read the upstream repository's licence | PENDING engineering review
